{{Top|leg}}
An '''interstellar jump schedule''' was a meticulously calculated timetable generated by on board and ground-based [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. The schedule was used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to execute [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps to arrive at locations at a predetermined time.
